rules.description: Caps Lock: Hyper Key (Cmd+Opt+Ctrl+Shift) on Hold, Escape on Tap
Hyper + Vim Navigation: H/J/K/L (Arrows), W/B (Word), 0/$ (Line), U/D (Page), I/O (Doc)
Hyper Application Launcher (Zero Conflict): Return (Ghostty), Shift+Return (Kitty), Space (Raycast), C (Clipboard), F (Search), S (Safari), M (Mail)
Right Shift / Right Control: Tap alone for Language Switch (Ctrl+Space), Hold for Modifier
Hold Command+Q for 600ms to Quit Application (Swallows Accidental Taps)
RK H81: Swap Command and Option keys (Device Isolated)
RK H81: Map Windows Mode Multimedia Keys (Finder, Safari, Mail, Calculator)
RK H81: Map Mac Mode Fn Multimedia Keys (Finder, Safari, Mail, Calculator)
Hyper + Window Management: Left/Right Half, Maximize, Center, Multi-Display hopping
